title: God of War: Sons of Sparta (2D side-scroller; Mega Cat Studios with Santa Monica Studio, published by Sony Interactive Entertainment; on PS5 since 12 Feb 2026) comes to PS4 on Mon 16 Nov 2026 with a free update adding two modes on PS4 and PS5: Hermes (speedrun timer, splits, persistent scoreboard; unlocked by finishing once or by a start-menu code Up, Up, Down, Down, Left, Right, Left, Right, L1, R1, Touchpad) and Erebus (you and every enemy die in one hit); mode chosen per save, can't be changed; PS Store India 15 Nov: PS5 ₹2,497, Digital Deluxe ₹3,330, PS4 price not listed
headline: God of War Spin-Off Hits PS4 Monday, 2 Free Modes

sources.outlet: PS Store India (product page, read 15 Nov 2026 ~08:15 IST)

Free content update adds two new modes t: VGC ('new patch that adds new modes to both PS4 and PS5 versions')
Push Square ('free update for PS5 owners'; 'both current PS5 owners and any new players on PS4')
Mode chosen when starting a new game and: VGC (selected upon starting a new game and selecting a save slot)
Out on PS5 since 12 February 2026: Gematsu ('first launched for PlayStation 5 on February 12, 2026')
Push Square ('debuted on PS5 in February')
Story: young Kratos and his brother Deim: VGC ('Kratos' youth during his harsh training at the Agoge alongside his brother Deimos')
